title: Software use, licences and privileged user installations need operating evidence
remediation: Deployment software asset and endpoint administration owners approve installation and peer-to-peer use rules. Record applicable licence entitlements and reconcile constrained quantities. Demonstrate allowed privileged installation, denied ordinary-user installation and monitoring. Collect software exception and peer-to-peer restrictions where applicable and track implementation gaps.

milestones.title: Collect entitlement and installation policy records, an approved and refused installation, monitoring receipts and any applicable sharing restrictions
